card.text: Explore Philosophia in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT 1873 shape model
shape.summary: Convex light-curve reconstruction; 101 km volume-equivalent diameter (±5 km). The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: DAMIT 1873 radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 50.5 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
